items.title: Grammar stage 5: measure and prove
items.body: Lock the census and equivalence baselines, re-run the seeded digest and both suite halves, and record the exit criteria in the design doc.

items.title: Effect families switch to the grammar
items.body: Twelve families (removal, damage, card draw, tokens, counters, pump, restrictions, mana, …) move from per-shape parsers to the one dispatcher, each with a failing test and a byte-identical or rules-correct game digest. The effect-parser ratchet may only fall.

items.title: Triggers on an event bus
items.body: TriggerSpec over the same grammar, real trigger stack items in APNAP order, and upkeep and end-step triggers for the roughly 940 pool cards that have them.

items.title: Engine rules stop reading classifier tags
items.body: On-draw triggers, ETB surveil and graveyard return, impulse draw and the sorcery-speed lockout read parsed effects; tags remain AI hints only.

items.title: Marvel Super Heroes in the card database
items.body: The set is still missing; the refresh needs an environment that can reach mtgjson.com.
